snippet.title: Mini Crawler - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
In this classic first-person Dungeon Crawler game with voxel graphics you play as a The Knight seeking to rescue his Princess. Collect powerful artifacts and defeat foes, play in Story Mode or in infinite Arcade Mode.

Published by Xeneder Team
Also released on PlayStation 5 (Cross-Buy)

#ps4 #playstation4 #xenederteam #theforeseenarcade #minicrawler
